author: GamerKitty Euphoric
title: Looking for artist for YouTube graphics and animations
content: Trying this again... but .... better. Looking for an artist. No, this isn't bot bait. (( Read till the end )) I need artists who can work with me to create several graphics for use in my you tube videos. AI not allowed. I can tell if you use AI so don't even try... Needs: Animal Art - Must be able to draw animals well. Animation - need a 30-60 second animation, this is not a tiny project. English - Must speak and be fluent in English as a second language at least to avoid miscommunication. Payment - Must take Stripe, Paypal, or Wise. No other options. Artists, to prove to me you are doing it, I will request to screen-share 5-10 seconds of you drawing on discord. No AI "artist" will be accepted. I'm not Anti-AI, but, I'm not okay with people using AI then tricking people into buying AI "Art" under fraudulent belief that it's human made. I will run all art given through an AI detector. Thank you. This project is going to be multiple layers. I need at least 3 animations, if not more, I will be picky who I pick. Please respond to this message to show me your work, and link your vgen, or other art accounts. thank you. READ THE FOLLOWING: to avoid the bs I'm dealing with now, this post will NOT be checked. No one who posts on this post will get considered for this position. INSTEAD Fill out this form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc_cWKVYph2pqC-2Z2n81_cE5Xh8E3OfEiR9iy_znstTIa2Kg/viewform?usp=send_form Repeat. No one who posts on this thread will be considered, and, furthermore, posting on my thread will tell me you're a bot, and might get you blocked ... You've been warned. Clients, feel free to use this thread as a blockchain to block bots. I got over 700 responses on my last post in various locations. D; so I'm praying I get better replies this way. Thank you.
